Official list prices with source links and verification dates · cache-hit and off-peak aware cost estimates · free, no sign-up

Reflex Hub is a free toolkit for developers choosing an LLM API. It helps you estimate monthly token costs from vendors' published price lists, look up model specifications such as context window and supported modalities, and trace every price back to its official source. Prices are recorded in the vendor's original currency (CNY or USD per 1M tokens) with a verification date — estimates are for budgeting, not vendor bills.

How we handle pricing data

Official list prices. Prices are vendors' published list prices per 1M tokens, in the original billing currency (CNY or USD). Promotional discounts, resource packs and free tiers are not included unless a page says so.

Verifiable sources. Every model page links to the official vendor page it was checked against, with a verification date. The most recent price verification across the library is 2026-10-28; each page shows its own date.

Estimates, not bills. Cost estimates apply fixed usage assumptions (shown on each page). They do not equal a vendor's actual invoice and do not constitute purchase advice.

Editorial independence. Reflex Hub is an independent third-party data compilation and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any vendor. Vendor names and trademarks belong to their respective owners.
